name: fifa-public-api-mcp

tools.name: search_competitions
tools.description: Start here. Find a FIFA competition (the FIFA World Cup, Women's World Cup, club competitions and more) by name or fragment, e.g. 'world cup'. Returns the matching competitions, each with the string idCompetition that every other tool builds on.

name.description: Competition name or fragment, e.g. 'world cup'

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: Get details for one FIFA competition by its idCompetition (name, organizer, type). Use search_competitions first if you only have the competition's name.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.description: List a competition's seasons/editions (e.g. each World Cup year), newest first, with start and end dates. Takes an idCompetition; returns the idSeason that stage, fixture, and squad lookups need.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_season
tools.description: Get one season/edition (e.g. the 2026 FIFA World Cup) by idSeason: its dates, participating member associations, host teams, and resolved crest/logo image URLs.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: list_stages
tools.description: List a season's stages, e.g. Group Stage, Round of 16, Final. Takes idCompetition + idSeason; returns the idStage used to scope fixtures and match lookups.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List FIFA countries and member associations (reference data), each with its idCountry.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: list_confederations
tools.description: List the six FIFA confederations (UEFA, CONMEBOL, CONCACAF, CAF, AFC, OFC), each with its idConfederation.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: List a competition's matches: fixtures, kickoff times (UTC), and final scores for a season (e.g. every 2026 World Cup game). Takes idCompetition + idSeason; narrow with idStage/idGroup. Pagination is non-functional, so pass a large `count` for a full list; no continuation token is returned.

count.description: Max matches in one request (FIFA default 50). Set high for a full list.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_match_timeline
tools.description: Get one match's event timeline in order: goals, cards, substitutions, and other key events. Takes idCompetition + idSeason + idStage + idMatch (idMatch comes from get_matches).

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_live_match
tools.description: Get rich detail for one match: starting lineups, substitutes, officials, attendance, and weather, plus live score and status. Works for any match state (a not-yet-started match has an empty lineup and a null score). Takes idCompetition + idSeason + idStage + idMatch.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Get a national team or club by its idTeam: name, abbreviation, country, home city, and stadium. Surfaces idStadium so you can chain to get_stadium.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

tools.name: get_stadium
tools.description: Get a stadium/venue by its idStadium: name, city, and capacity.

raw.description: Return FIFA's untouched payload instead of the trimmed shape

language.description: Language code passed through to the API and used for name selection

instructions:
Read-only access to the public FIFA data API. Covers FIFA football competitions (the men's and women's World Cups, club competitions and more), their seasons, stages, fixtures and results, and live match detail (lineups, officials, attendance, weather), plus teams, stadiums, and reference data (countries, confederations).

Most lookups chain string IDs: search_competitions -> list_seasons -> list_stages -> get_matches -> get_match_timeline / get_live_match. get_team and get_stadium take IDs surfaced by those calls. Example: the 2026 FIFA World Cup is idCompetition=17, idSeason=285023.

Gaps to know: no league tables or standings are available; get_matches has no working pagination (pass a large count for a full list); get_live_match returns data for any match state, so a not-yet-started match has an empty lineup and a null score.
